profile.headline: Software Engineer & Process Design Strategist | Educator | Bridging Deep Technical Expertise, Intention & Human Understanding
profile.summary:
I understand technology deeply, but think beyond it, about people, purpose, and the influences that drive them. My aim is to help organizations build with intention, communicate with clarity, and align technology with human purpose.

My technical background as a software engineer and process design strategist has given me the tools to understand complex systems; my passion for philosophy and human behavior gives me the lens to question them.

As an educator, I’ve witnessed how understanding new technology reshapes the way people think, collaborate, and create. It builds confidence, awakens curiosity, and reminds me of my purpose: to help people realize their own potential.

positions.title: Code Red | Technical Course Instructor |  Introduction to Programming using Python
positions.locationName: Manhattan, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Developed and deliver a comprehensive 12-week Python programming curriculum with weekly lessons, interactive exercises, and a final capstone project emphasizing independent problem-solving and applied learning.
• Scaled the program up from just one initial in-person session led by three instructors (~20 students cap) to four concurrent sessions, two in-person and two virtual (~120 students cap), by recruiting and mentoring nine additional instructors, in turn expanding reach and instructional capacity.
• Collaborate with fellow instructors, global peers, and program sponsors from the UBS Women in Technology Network to continuously refine course content, learning materials, pacing, and instructional methods based on participant feedback and performance assessments.
positions.insights: Instructional Design, Curriculum Development and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer | Automation & Infrastructure Architect
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•  Develop and implement custom automation workflows to streamline production support operations by identifying inefficiencies, simplifying overly complex process design, and reducing manual intervention - in turn preventing production incidents caused by non-value-adding steps and accelerating resolution times when incidents do inevitably occur
•  Serve as product owner and full-stack engineer for a global, in-house Windows desktop application, managing end-to-end delivery from stakeholder engagement and solution design to infrastructure configuration, code deployment, and 24/7 production support for users across the globe. 
     - I independently architect and develop new application features, configure and maintain Linux hosts, networking components, api connections, and tool integrations.
     - I design and manage Sybase databases, oversee Secrets Management and Privileged Access Management, and update environment configurations following backend changes such as database migrations or account rotations. 
     - I continuously monitor application health by tracking system metrics (CPU, memory, disk, and critical services) and quickly diagnosing and resolving failures in daemon processes. 
•  Engineered a complete Ubuntu Autoinstall framework for fully unattended OS provisioning by building a custom ISO, eliminating manual setup for VMs and bare-metal hosts, improving install consistency, scalability, and reliability across environments
•  Continuously drive modernization and enhancement of legacy applications by periodically re-evaluating infrastructure design to identify opportunities to better leverage Microsoft Azure Cloud Services and other emerging technologies, eliminating deprecated dependencies, and reviewing existing code to ensure it is high-quality, well-documented, and optimized for scalability, maintainability, and performance.
positions.insights: Application Lifecycle Management, Application Architecture and +11 skills

positions.title: Graduate Talent Program | Analyst & Program Co-Lead
positions.description:
• Co-led UBS’s annual Graduate Talent Program, supporting ~ 30 of my fellow early-career peers by coordinating professional development, mentorship, volunteer, and networking opportunities, and overseeing program operations and budgeting across multiple sub-streams to ensure consistent delivery of high value, measurable outcomes and increase engagement
• Partnered with cross-functional leaders and HR business partners to align program objectives with firm-wide talent development and retention strategies, driving overall program efficiency and participant satisfaction through continuous feedback integration
positions.insights: Program Management, Leadership Development and +7 skills

positions.title: Procurement Intern
positions.description:
• Compiled and analyzed hardware and software purchase data to complete the agency’s Asset Inventory Certification, identifying utilization trends and discrepancies to inform fiscal year budget allocation.
• Conducted GUI, accessibility, and usability testing on the agency’s Board International application, identifying and documenting interface issues prior to product launch to ensure a smooth production rollout.
• Supported the upgrade and data migration of the branch-specific administrative tracking system (PCMS), performing comparison and installation testing to validate accuracy and functionality of the new system version
positions.insights: Data Analysis, Quality Assurance and +7 skills
